newsitem.title: CHINA: China Xinjiang '96 grain output seen at 7.8 mln T.
newsitem.headline: China Xinjiang '96 grain output seen at 7.8 mln T.

text.p: China's northwestern region of Xinjian is expected to produce 7.8 million tonnes of grain in 1996 despite devastating floods this year, the China Business Times said on Thursday.
The region's cotton and beet output would reach 1.05 million tonnes and 3.4 million tonnes, the newspaper said. It gave no comparative figures.
The newspaper attributed the increase to low-interest loans for farmers and an increase in the price at which the government buys grain and cotton from farmers.
The government also curbed fertiliser price rises and ensured stable supply, the newspaper said.
The region recorded a bumper harvest for the 19th consecutive year, it said.
Direct economic losses from floods in mid-July alone totalled 700 million yuan ($84.3 million), the newspaper said. It gave no further details.
